verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking platform, a kind of product that could plausibly expose a public API, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a public API, API versioning, or a deprecation policy. Its integrations (QuickBooks/Xero sync, Plaid connections) and the llms.txt file are adjacent features, not versioned APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
